about: The Workbench icons of the Daggorath drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is the game's own program icon, the wizard (src/dod.ico, as art/daggorath.png). Daggorath-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Daggorath.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's Daggorath.info. conf.info, sound.info and saved.info are the game's data drawers'.
